chunks.arabic_text: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: And in the narration of al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ أَمَةً لَهُ وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا

translations.en: Regarding a man who freed a female slave belonging to him and made her emancipation her dowry, then divorced her before consummating the marriage

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: «يَسْتَسْعِيهَا فِي نِصْفِ قِيمَتِهَا فَإِنْ أَبَتْ كَانَ لَهَا يَوْمٌ وَلَهُ يَوْمٌ فِي الْخِدْمَةِ».

translations.en: He said: "He makes her work to pay off half of her value. If she refuses, then she has one day and he has one day in service."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: «فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهَا وَلَدٌ وَلَهُ مَالٌ أَدَّى عَنْهَا نِصْفَ قِيمَتِهَا وَعَتَقَتْ».

translations.en: He said: "If she has a child and he has wealth, he pays on her behalf half of her value, and she becomes free."

en.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a man who emancipates his female slave and makes that emancipation her dowry, then divorces her before consummation. It explains how half of her value is to be recovered and sets out practical rulings concerning her service and the possibility of payment leading to her full freedom.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man frees his slave woman as her dowry and then divorces her before consummation?

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: he emancipated or set free from slavery
